title: Your First Weekend at Agnes Scott College, Shared as Cards
description: A guide to the essential traditions, campus hubs, and local spots that define the first few days for new Scotties in Decatur.

cards.title: Sign the Honor Pledge
cards.subtitle: A cornerstone tradition of campus life
cards.notes: Join your class to formally commit to the Honor System, a defining aspect of the Agnes Scott community since 1906.
cards.short_summary: New students sign the Honor Pledge during orientation to uphold standards of honesty and personal integrity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Honor Pledge Ceremony is a key part of New Student Orientation, typically held on the first Friday of the move-in period.
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students during the Legacy orientation program.

cards.title: First Meal at Evans
cards.subtitle: The main campus dining hub
cards.notes: Gather with new friends for all-you-care-to-eat meals featuring international fare and made-to-order stations.
cards.short_summary: Evans Dining Hall is the primary dining location on campus, offering a variety of meal options for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Dining Hall is the central all-you-care-to-eat location on campus for students to catch up with friends.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend hours typically include brunch and dinner services.

cards.title: Explore Alston Center
cards.subtitle: The heart of student activity
cards.notes: Visit the Hub to check out recreational equipment like hammocks or bikes for a relaxing afternoon on the quad.
cards.short_summary: Alston Campus Center houses student organizations, a fitness room, and the campus 'Hub' for equipment rentals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Alston Campus Center includes a fitness room and the Hub, where students can check out recreational equipment free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Central campus location; accessible with student ID for specific rooms and equipment.

cards.title: Find a Study Nook
cards.subtitle: Historic architecture and quiet spaces
cards.notes: Scope out your favorite study spot in this historic building, which offers late-night hours on Sundays.
cards.short_summary: McCain Library provides extensive research resources and diverse study environments for Agnes Scott students.
cards.evidence_claim: McCain Library is open until 1 a.m. on Sundays during the academic year for student use.
cards.source_title: Hours and Contact | Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Student ID required for late-night swipe access after 10:30 p.m. on Sundays.

cards.title: Relax on the Quad
cards.subtitle: The central green space
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or a borrowed hammock to the main quad for a classic campus afternoon outdoors.
cards.short_summary: Woodruff Quad is the central outdoor gathering space for events, relaxation, and campus traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Woodruff Quadrangle is a primary site for campus activities, including the 'Rushing the Quad' tradition during Black Cat week.
cards.access_notes: Open public outdoor space on campus.

cards.title: Late Night at Mollie's
cards.subtitle: Casual dining and snacks
cards.notes: Grab a burger or a wrap at this lower-level Alston spot, open late on weekends for a quick bite.
cards.short_summary: Mollie's Grill offers a variety of grilled favorites and convenience items in the Alston Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Mollie's Grill is located in the Alston Campus Center and has weekend hours from 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Located in the lower level of Alston; accepts meal swipes and declining balance.

cards.title: Stargaze at Bradley
cards.subtitle: Astronomy and planetarium shows
cards.notes: Check the calendar for monthly Friday open houses to view the stars through the Beck Telescope.
cards.short_summary: Bradley Observatory hosts monthly open houses with lectures and telescope viewings for the community.
cards.evidence_claim: The observatory hosts a free open house every month during the semester on a Friday evening.
cards.source_title: Open House Series - Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Open houses typically start at 7 p.m. or 8 p.m. on select Fridays.

cards.title: Walk to Decatur Square
cards.subtitle: Local shops and dining nearby
cards.notes: Take a short walk north to explore the local boutiques and cafes in the heart of downtown Decatur.
cards.short_summary: Decatur Square is a vibrant district within walking distance of campus, offering numerous student-friendly spots.
cards.evidence_claim: Agnes Scott's campus is a short three-block walk from the Decatur MARTA station and the surrounding square.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via a pedestrian tunnel beneath the railroad tracks from campus.

cards.title: Swim at Woodruff
cards.subtitle: Recreation and fitness facilities
cards.notes: Visit the Olympic-sized pool for open swim hours or use the track for a weekend morning run.
cards.short_summary: The Woodruff Athletic Complex features a pool, gym, and track for student recreation and varsity sports.
cards.evidence_claim: Open swim hours are available for students in the Olympic-sized swimming pool located in the Woodruff Athletic Complex.
cards.access_notes: Student ID required for entry; check seasonal hours for the pool and track.

cards.title: Coffee at Black Cat
cards.subtitle: A student-favorite cafe
cards.notes: Enjoy a specialty coffee or smoothie in this cozy cafe named after the college's oldest tradition.
cards.short_summary: Black Cat Coffee is a campus cafe serving Ebrik Coffee and snacks, located in the Alston Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Black Cat Coffee is located adjacent to Mollie's Grille and serves a full range of coffees and light snacks.
cards.access_notes: Open weekdays and select weekend hours; accepts declining balance dollars.
